acceptance: Team operations cannot weaken local root confinement or user-origin learning boundaries.
verifiedBy: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace && pnpm test

offByDefaultAndOptIn: membrane-protocol #[test] disabled_opt_in_default_has_valid_bounds: TeamSyncOptInV1::disabled() (every field empty, enabled=false) is the only well-formed disabled value.

membrane-protocol #[test] a_disabled_opt_in_carrying_leftover_identifiers_is_invalid: a disabled record with a leftover tenant_id fails has_valid_bounds(), so a stale opt-in cannot be reinterpreted as live scope.

membrane-runtime #[test] default_off_installation_never_admits_even_a_perfectly_trusted_policy: admit_team_policy_with_opt_in with TeamSyncOptInV1::disabled() and a verifier that returns encrypted=true/authorized=true/scope-preserved=true still returns SyncNotOptedIn/admitted=false -- opt-in state, not verifier trust, is the first gate.

crypt-store #[test] refuses_without_opt_in_and_writes_nothing: commit_team_policy_admission on a fresh in-memory store (no opt-in ever called) returns TeamSyncStoreError::NotOptedIn and the audit log stays empty.

crypt-store #[test] opt_in_and_opt_out_roundtrip: team_sync_opt_in_status() is None until enable_team_sync_opt_in() is called, and reverts to None (and admission fails closed again) after disable_team_sync_opt_in().
tenantTeamScopeCannotBroaden: membrane-runtime #[test] opting_in_to_one_team_never_admits_a_different_team_policy: opting in to team-1 and presenting a well-formed, trust-verified team-2 policy yields TenantOrTeamMismatch.
crypt-store #[test] refuses_when_tenant_or_team_does_not_match_opt_in: same gate enforced independently and durably at the storage layer; no audit row is written.
keyRotationFailsClosedInsteadOfSilentlyF: membrane-runtime #[test] a_rotated_key_is_never_silently_followed: an envelope key_id that differs from the opted-in key_id yields KeyMismatch even though the policy is otherwise well-formed and would pass a trusted verifier.

crypt-store #[test] refuses_when_key_id_does_not_match_opt_in_key: same gate enforced durably at the storage layer; no audit row is written; a real rotation requires an explicit local enable_team_sync_opt_in call with the new key_id.
existingTrustAndReplayGuaranteesAreUnwea: membrane-runtime #[test] opt_in_gate_never_overrides_untrusted_encryption: with opt-in/tenant/key all matching, an UntrustedVerifier (encrypted=false) still yields UntrustedEncryption -- the new opt-in gates only add restrictions in front of admit_team_policy, they do not relax or bypass its bounds/encryption/authorization/user-scope checks.

crypt-store #[test] local_replay_is_rejected_even_when_runtime_claims_admitted: commit_team_policy_admission re-derives generation monotonicity itself from durable storage -- even when the caller passes runtime_admitted=true for a stale or repeated generation, the local commit is rejected reason="replay" and state does not advance. This is a second, storage-layer replay defense that survives a process restart, in addition to the existing in-memory verifier.current_generation check in admit_team_policy.

crypt-store #[test] runtime_rejection_is_recorded_but_never_advances_generation: a runtime-rejected attempt is still durably audited (admitted=false) but never advances membrane_team_sync_state, so a corrected/legitimate resend of the same generation can still be admitted afterward.
cannotWeakenLocalRootConfinementOrLearni: engine/crates/membrane-protocol/src/team_policy.rs #[test] local_root_scope_is_never_valid (pre-existing behavior, re-asserted): TeamPolicyScopeV1::LocalRoot in a policy's scopes always fails has_valid_bounds(); this task adds no path around that check.

crypt-store #[test] schema_has_no_column_that_could_hold_key_material_or_plaintext: PRAGMA table_info on all three new tables (membrane_team_sync_opt_in, membrane_team_sync_state, membrane_team_sync_audit_log) is inspected for banned substrings (key_material, secret, plaintext, private_key); none is present -- no plaintext secret or key material can ever be persisted by this module.

By construction: engine/crates/crypt-store/src/team_sync.rs contains no SQL statement referencing the memories, memory_quarantine, context_feedback, or membrane_temporal_fact tables (the tables that hold user-origin learning content and its scope_id boundary) -- verified both by code inspection and by tests/team/team-policy.test.mjs's 'crypt-store persists team sync fail-closed & never touches learning-boundary tables' test, which greps the module source for FROM/INTO/UPDATE against each of those table names and asserts no match. Team sync therefore has no code path capable of reading, writing, or rescoping a user-origin memory, regardless of what any admitted policy contains.

membrane_team_sync_state and membrane_team_sync_audit_log are new, task-owned tables outside memdb.rs's versioned migration chain (created lazily via idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, the same pattern engine/crates/crypt-store/src/temporal.rs already uses) -- LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION and every existing migrate()/backout_* function in engine/crates/crypt-store/src/memdb.rs are unmodified by this task, so no existing table's confinement behavior changes.

observed: Team sync ships off by default (TeamSyncOptInV1::disabled(), no opt-in row) and requires an explicit, well-formed local opt-in (tenant_id + team_id + key_id + enabled_at) before admit_team_policy_with_opt_in or crypt-store's commit_team_policy_admission will admit anything; both layers independently re-derive the opt-in/tenant-team/key checks (defense in depth, not a single shared boolean) and both fail closed -- refusing before any transaction opens and before any state or audit row is written -- on a missing opt-in record, a tenant/team scope mismatch, or a key_id mismatch (i.e. a key rotation the local operator has not yet acknowledged). None of the pre-existing admit_team_policy guarantees (structural bounds incl. LocalRoot-scope rejection, replay-by-generation, trusted encryption, trusted authorization, user-origin-learning-scope preservation) are altered, weakened, or bypassed; the new gates only run in front of them. crypt-store adds a second, durable generation-replay defense that survives a process restart. No plaintext secret or key material is ever part of the new schema (structurally verified via PRAGMA table_info), and no code path in the new module touches memories, memory_quarantine, context_feedback, membrane_temporal_fact, or any scope_id-bearing learning table, so team operations cannot weaken local root confinement or user-origin learning boundaries. This task is implemented with 7 new deterministic Rust #[test] functions in engine/crates/membrane-protocol/src/team_policy.rs (the file had no #[cfg(test)] module before this task), 6 new #[test] functions in engine/crates/membrane-runtime/src/team_policy.rs (likewise none before this task), and 11 new #[test] functions in the new engine/crates/crypt-store/src/team_sync.rs, plus 2 new node:test cases in tests/team/team-policy.test.mjs (alongside 3 pre-existing ones), all written in this change and left unexecuted pending cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace and pnpm test at the Book 3 Wave 4 phased gate, per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md. Status is recorded as pending_book_gate, not pass.
